hero.intro: Here you can look around and read about the work I've made. As a frontend developer, I live and breathe for UX/UI and user experience. I made it my mission to make navigating platforms as effortless and intuitive as possible for the user.

home.aboutText: Frontend Developer specializing in UX/UI. Dedicated to crafting seamless digital interfaces where functionality meets flawless design. My goal is simple: making the complex feel effortless.
home.contactPitch: Turns out you're missing someone like me on your team — so don't hesitate to reach out.

portfolio.description: A collection of projects where I've combined design and code.

datanest.title: DataNest — AI Marketing Assistant
datanest.description: An AI-powered analytics workspace for marketing teams — ask questions in plain language, track conversions across channels, and catch invalid traffic and VPN proxies before they skew the numbers.
datanest.considerations: I wanted the AI conversation to feel like the centerpiece of the product without hiding the underlying data, so the metrics stay one click away in a persistent sidebar instead of being buried in a separate view.

finance.title: Finance overview
finance.description: A comprehensive financial overview featuring real-time data visualization, expense tracking, and interactive charts to monitor personal or business wealth.
finance.considerations: The biggest challenge was fitting a lot of numbers on screen without overwhelming the user, so I leaned on charts over tables wherever a trend mattered more than an exact figure.

chatbot.title: AI chatbot
chatbot.description: An intelligent conversational interface built with natural language processing to provide instant customer support and automated task handling.
chatbot.considerations: I focused on designing clear loading and typing states so the wait for an AI response never feels like the interface has stalled.

bakery.title: Bakery insight viewboard
bakery.description: A specialized analytics platform for bakeries, tracking daily sales trends, inventory levels, and production efficiency in a clean, visual layout.
bakery.considerations: The dashboard had to be usable by staff on the bakery floor, not just office admin, so I prioritized large, glanceable numbers over dense tables.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce App
ecommerce.description: A full-stack shopping experience with secure checkout, product browsing, and order tracking built for a smooth path from browsing to purchase.
ecommerce.considerations: I kept the checkout flow to as few steps as possible, since every extra field or page is a place a customer can drop off.
